structured.answer: I haven't really decided. If I had to pick, I'd go with Harel, which I know, and its "כספי (שקלי)" track. It shows 0% for מניות and 0% for מט"ח, the fee is "0.57% מהחיסכון", and it gives "4.25%" over 3 years. That looks closest to my deposit. But I'll ask you, or the bank, before I sign anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of filter buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Too many buttons: 'S&P 500', 'עוקב מדדי מניות', 'גמיש'. I couldn't tell which one is the safe one. I only recognised אג"ח ממשלות and 'כספי (שקלי)', and I didn't press any of them.

stuck.where: The circles next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' in every row
stuck.why: The green and yellow are close, and the circle is half filled. I couldn't tell what it means, so I just read the two numbers beside it.

stuck.where: Screen 2, column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I can't compare them. 'לפני דמי ניהול' means the fee still has to come off, and I don't know how much that leaves.
How can more than all of it be in shares? It frightened me.

used: The title 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and the selected button 'קופת גמל להשקעה 143'
Company names I know: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב
Rows called 'כספי (שקלי)' and 'אג"ח סחיר', looking for 0% shares
Column 'דמי ניהול, ממוצע 2025' – '0.57% מהחיסכון' and '0% מההפקדות'
skimmed: The share rows with big returns like '24.04%' and '26.39%', which are not for me
The company header lines with fee ranges
skipped: Screens 6–15, because I was tired after five
The 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' link
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדד, עוקב מדדי מניות, עוקב מדדים – גמיש
כספי (שקלי), which I guess means money in shekels but I'm not sure
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a number
'עוד לא דווח' with the orange mark
The dotted underlines under the numbers
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is as safe as a bank deposit
A comparison with a bank deposit's interest
What the fee comes to in shekels on my money
Any word on whether I can lose money in the כספי track

findings.what: Dark background and grey small text, hard to read even with glasses
findings.where: All screens, especially the column headings and the 'מהחיסכון/מההפקדות' labels

findings.what: Every row repeats 'מניות', 'מט"ח', 'מהחיסכון', 'מההפקדות', '3 שנים', '5 שנים', and I have to read them all again each time to find what's different
The percentages sit next to a coloured circle and I have to match green/yellow dots to the circle, and the colours look alike
Too many numbers on one screen, which made me anxious
English letters on the first screen, so it felt not for me
No explanation of which tracks are safe; I had to guess from 0% shares
Many returns are missing ('פחות מ־3 שנים')
Very long lines; the row name is far right and the money column is far left, and I lose my place
